items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The mention of 'Mac' is a mishearing/correction by the interviewer to 'McCoy' (Tyner). The interviewee confirms the relationship with McCoy Tyner, not Mac.

ctx.x: Stamm-pede is a play on words because of the spelling, S-t-a - double em hyphen p-e-d-e. That was named after Marvin Stamm, the trumpeter. It featured him playing the melody. I wanted to feature him on something, because I was a strong admirer of his playing. This song -- I wanted to -- this was one of my earliest experiments with what I call -- with what I refer to as fourths, that musical interval that became of highly prevalent in --
